trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — that screen is your checklist, and it opens once the story is done. Do not let the name fool you: this is not a true 100% of everything in the game, it is closer to 60% of it, so the list is long but finite. The big blocks are 200 of 277 base vehicle models (scan them with the WAiNK phone app), 100 of 255 animals (study them through binoculars), 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions, every robbery type, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race, and every Bret quest. Chip away at it in free roam after the story and the gold pops when the checklist hits 100%.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Scan vehicles with WAiNK (200 of 277 base models) and study animals with binoculars (100 of 255).
Collect 50 of 66 weapons and finish 70 of 80 challenges.
Do 100 optional missions, all robbery types, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and every Bret quest.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. The checklist stays open in free roam after the story; the only time-gated piece is the first meditation spot, which belongs to its own trophy.

Track your total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find un-done spots under Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots. For the 100% checklist the bar rises to 300, so keep going past 250 if you want the platinum checklist too.

Clear under-the-bridge passes first — 202 exist and they are the quickest.
Mix in stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps until the counter hits 250.
Keep going to 300 if you are chasing the 100% checklist.

Story missions will carry you through much of the map on their own; the leftovers are yours to mop up in free roam.

In free roam, visit every region of Leonida by road, air and water.
Check the map for areas you have never visited and go there.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties for a total of $160,000. Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on the in-game phone. Each garage gives you one parking slot for a car you want to keep, so they are useful as well as required. The prices: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Save up and buy them one by one as money comes in.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone.
Buy the cheapest garages first: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, then Persistence Road $7,600.
Keep buying as money comes in, up to Atlantic Court at $40,000.
Own all 8 garages — $160,000 in total.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. Garages stay for sale in free roam.

sources.fact: Bought via the Vice City Real Estate phone app; one parking slot each
